author: Chris Montcalmo
title: Royal Farms set to open new Rosedale location - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Montcalmo ,
11 hours ago ROSEDALE, MD—Royal Farms, the popular convenience store and gas station chain famous for its World-Famous Chicken, is set to bolster its presence in the Baltimore area with the grand opening of a new location in Rosedale.
The new store, located at 2 Philadelphia Court (21237), is scheduled to officially open its doors on Wednesday, December 4, 2025. It will operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, providing the community with round-the-clock access to fresh food, fuel, and convenience items.
Soft Opening Event Ahead of Grand Launch
To mark the milestone, Royal Farms will host a ticketed “Get Ready to ROFO” soft opening event on November 24 and 25, 2025. This special preview will allow community members to tour the new facility and sample its signature offerings, including a complimentary meal from the soft opening menu. Free tickets for the event are available through Eventbrite .
“Opening a new store in Rosedale is a proud moment that reinforces our long-standing commitment to the Baltimore area,” said Stephanie Pitt, District Leader of Royal Farms. “This beautiful new store represents a significant investment in the community, bringing new jobs and providing reliable, 24/7 access to high-quality fresh food and fuel.”
The Rosedale location is designed for maximum convenience, featuring:
12 Fuel Dispensers 24/7 Service Fresh, Made-to-Order Food: This includes Royal Farms’ renowned chicken, sandwiches, and a variety of breakfast options. Save Money with ROFO Rewards
Royal Farms encourages the Rosedale community to join the ROFO Rewards loyalty program to maximize savings. Members can earn points, receive exclusive offers, and get fuel discounts by upgrading to RoFo Pay.
Earning Points: Members earn 2 points for every dollar spent in-store and 1 point for every gallon of gas purchased with RoFo Pay (excluding New Jersey stores). Perks: The program offers year-round savings, fuel discounts, and surprise freebie offers. Interested individuals can sign up for ROFO Rewards by downloading the Royal Farms app or registering online .
Royal Farms is also actively recruiting for positions at the new Rosedale store and other Maryland locations, offering competitive pay, medical and dental insurance, a 401(K)-retirement plan, and opportunities for advancement.
